paper: Planar point sets with many unit distances

files.label: Lemma 2.4
files.doc: Lemma 2.4, with nonempty referring to the window section.

files.label: Lemma 2.5
files.doc: Lemma 2.5: injectivity and the count of unordered unit pairs.

files.label: Lemma 2.6
files.doc: Lemma 2.6, in the standing Section 2 setup.

files.label: Proposition 3.2
files.doc: Proposition 3.2. All subfields are formed in the common cyclotomic field. The degree product states joint linear disjointness of this finite family.

files.label: Proposition 3.6
files.doc: Proposition 3.6. Compatible Frobenius means a representative whose restriction is Frobenius in every finite Galois subextension.

files.label: Proposition 3.7
files.doc: Proposition 3.7, the second numbered presentation of the class estimate.

files.label: Proposition 3.8
files.doc: Proposition 3.8, including all P1–P6 and uniform constants. The injective field maps implement the nested tower; nonsurjectivity makes successive inclusions proper. The base is the zeroth admissible field.

files.label: Proposition A.13
files.doc: Proposition A.13: a constant uniform in field, degree and signature.

files.label: Theorem 1.1
files.doc: Theorem 1.1, for infinitely many positive integer sizes.

files.label: Theorem 2.3
files.doc: Theorem 2.3: the geometric conclusion from a sequence of admissible data.

axioms.name: chebotarevSplitPrimes
axioms.doc: Neukirch VII §13: only the completely split Chebotarev case.

axioms.name: idealArithmeticFacts
axioms.doc: General arithmetic facts from Neukirch I §§1–5. Unique factorization, transport of ideals and multiplicativity of ideal norms also have their ordinary library interfaces; no counting inequality is assumed.

axioms.name: discriminantAndSplittingFacts
axioms.doc: Discriminants, unramified primes and finite splitting in towers. These are general identities, without a root-discriminant or tower bound.

axioms.name: minkowskiFractionalIdealLattice
axioms.doc: The full lattice theorem for a nonzero fractional ideal and one embedding from each conjugate pair. The window unfolding identity is not an axiom.

axioms.name: minkowskiIdealClassBound
axioms.doc: Only the Minkowski representative bound, with the signature factor.

axioms.name: cyclotomicCharacterFacts
axioms.doc: Prime cubic characters and the general conductor–discriminant formula. CRT and character multiplication retain their native library meanings.

axioms.name: primeNumberTheoremModThree
axioms.doc: Prime number theorem consequence for the fixed progression 1 modulo 3.

axioms.name: frattiniQuotientFacts
axioms.doc: General Frattini and basis facts; the relations are any chosen elements of the Frattini subgroup, not specifically the paper's Frobenius elements.

axioms.name: golodShafarevichCriterion
axioms.doc: Golod–Shafarevich at the odd prime 3, with nontriviality explicit.

axioms.name: unramifiedClassFieldCorrespondence
axioms.doc: Unramified class field theory and its profinite Galois correspondence. The last clause gives compatible Frobenius representatives, without imposing any splitting on any chosen infinite extension.

axioms.name: shafarevichCubicRelationBound
axioms.doc: Shafarevich's uniform relation estimate for totally real cubic bases only.
